[SWS_DM_01063] Transmission error behavior
⌈
In case of a PDID trans-
mission error, the DM shall use always the same order of periodicDIDs per client. Trans-
mission errors shall not influence this order, the DM shall continue to retry the trans-
mission and start the next PDID only after the PDID was transmitted successfully.
⌋
